author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: four in-phase wavy airflow lines; the outer two run the full height while the middle two stop at a filter band (top and bottom edges joining them), showing the blocked flow as in the reference. A first candidate with continuous lines and rungs read as 'HH' letters and was rejected; the rejected drawing likewise read as a ladder.
omissions: The short centre dashes on the band edges are dropped (a dash between lines 10 apart cannot sit 8 from both); the band edges are solid.
drawing_plan: Waves at x0 8/19/29/40 through knots y 6,13,20,24,28,35,42 with offsets 0,+2,0,-2,0,+2,0; middle waves broken between y=20 and y=28; band edges (19,20)-(29,20) and (19,28)-(29,28).
